styles.summary: Calm grid, generous space. For identity presentations.
styles.character: Everything sits on one grid and moves along it. Long holds, one colour change per beat, and the mark is the only thing that is ever centred.

styles.summary: Bright, precise, product-first. For feature announcements.
styles.character: Ease-out entrances, word-by-word text, enlarged product UI. Nothing on screen that is not about the message.

styles.summary: Cinematic, dense, confident. For launches of platforms and multi-tool products.
styles.character: Bursts and dives carry the energy at the start and end. The product tour in the middle uses hard cuts inside a fixed layout.

styles.summary: Typography is the hero. For type, design and writing tools, and brand manifestos.
styles.character: About one style change per second, on the music. Layout grids may stay visible. Poster-like frames.

styles.summary: A single poster frame that moves. For social and outdoor screens.
styles.character: A poster that moves. One idea, set as large as the frame allows, in a heavy grotesque or a condensed face; two colours, the brand colour and its inverse, swapped hard on the beat. Type is uncovered rather than faded: masks, blocks and slanted wipes, never a dissolve.

styles.summary: Interface up close, led by the cursor. For app demos.
styles.character: The interface is the hero, enlarged until its text is readable. The camera follows the cursor; nothing moves that the person using the app would not see move.

styles.summary: Calm, endless, object-like. For portfolio posts, covers and presentation backgrounds.
styles.character: One rig, constant speed, seamless loop. Tiles mix photos, single glyphs on solid colour and short words. Offer a normal and a closer camera variant.
